audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is absent from both layers: Arctic Assault (Q) knocks enemies into the air, and Last Breath only fires on an Airborne target.
audit.why: Sejuani's Q text is 'charges forward, knocking enemies into the air'; Yasuo's R 'Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion'. Her engage is therefore your ultimate's input. The mirror audit found the same thing from her side.
audit.corrected: From 6, her Arctic Assault charge is a free Last Breath target — hold R for it instead of forcing your own Q2 knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two lines claim Wind Wall blocks Permafrost and Winter's Wrath.
audit.why: Only Glacial Prison (R) carries the projectile flag. Permafrost (E) is a targeted stun on a max-Frost target and Winter's Wrath (W) is a melee arc — neither is walled.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall blocks the Glacial Prison bola and nothing else in her kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] says her Permafrost stun 'only triggers off ally procs'.
audit.why: Winter's Wrath applies Frost stacks by itself; Permafrost stuns any champion at maximum Frost, so she can stun you solo. Its own cooldown is 1.5s — the real clock is W (9s at rank 1 down to 5s).
audit.corrected: Break contact before her final Frost stack lands; the W cooldown, not the E, is the window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Yasuo six of seven rows and rated the lane 4/10.
audit.why: The already-audited sejuani side settled on: level 1 even, levels 2 through first item hers, 2+ items yours. A 49.03% win rate does not support an all-Yasuo chart either.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned in matched full/content pairs with ratings, whys rewritten to explain each side.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet flags this as a defect).
audit.why: Arctic Assault 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Winter's Wrath 9/8/7/6/5s, Glacial Prison 120/105/90s, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1, Last Breath 70s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the spikes and mid.

audit.why: packet suspectName 'Land Glacial Prison' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Glacial Prison is her real R name.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Permafrost and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. Her Frost stacks into the Permafrost stun decide it — never be stacked when you dash in.

edits.before: Sejuani's tank kit lacks the level-1 damage to trade with you.
edits.after: Neither commits at 1; Frost Armor blunts your opening poke.

edits.before: Her weak solo poke lets you press the lane at level 2.
edits.after: Arctic Assault knocks you up and Winter's Wrath follows.

edits.before: At 3 your Q and autos out-trade her low-damage abilities.
edits.after: Frost stacks into a Permafrost stun beat your level-3 trade.

edits.before: You keep out-trading her through levels 4-5 unpunished.
edits.after: Her W falls to 6s and keeps Frost stacked on you.

edits.before: Glacial Prison at 6 is a skill check you can Wind Wall.
edits.after: Glacial Prison stuns you if your wall is on cooldown.

edits.before: A crit item pushes your DPS past her tanky low-damage kit.
edits.after: Her armour and Frost Armor blunt your first crit item.

edits.before: Sejuani is a tank support/jungle pick with weak solo-lane damage — her Arctic Assault (Q) dash and Winter's Wrath (W) do little to a mobile Yasuo, and you out-trade her freely with Steel Tempest (Q) and empowered autos while she stacks Frost passive slowly.
edits.after: Sejuani's Arctic Assault (Q) knocks you airborne — from 6 that charge is the exact input Last Breath (R) needs, so answer it with R. Before then, Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost and Permafrost (E) stuns at max stacks, so break off before the last stack lands.

edits.before: Glacial Prison (R) is a game-changing engage but it's a single skillshot on a long cooldown; if she lands it a gank can flip the fight, so this window is a skill check — Wind Wall (W) can block the R bola and neutralize it entirely.
edits.after: Glacial Prison (R) is a 120s bola and Wind Wall blocks it outright — hold the wall for the bola, never for her W. Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1) knocks you airborne, and Last Breath fires on any airborne target, so her charge is your kill window.

edits.before: With a crit item you out-DPS her tanky-but-low-damage kit; her Permafrost passive stun only triggers off ally procs, so 1v1 she can't burst you and you win extended trades.
edits.after: With a crit item you out-DPS her tanky kit, but Permafrost (E) stuns off her own Winter's Wrath stacks, so spend the wall or the distance before her final stack, not after it lands.

edits.before: Sejuani becomes a peel/engage tank with no solo kill threat; you gap-close, Wind Wall her R and W, and carry the fight — she survives but can't stop your damage.
edits.after: Sejuani becomes a peel/engage tank with no solo kill threat; you gap-close, Wind Wall the R bola only, and carry the fight — she survives but cannot stop your damage.

edits.before: You control levels 1-3: Sejuani's damage is built for tank-support play, so her Arctic Assault (Q) and Winter's Wrath (W) barely scratch you, and you out-trade her with Steel Tempest (Q) and empowered autos while she farms passively.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are hers: Frost Armor gives armour, MR and slow immunity out of combat, and Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost toward the Permafrost (E) stun, so trade in short bursts and step out before the final stack lands on you.

edits.before: You stay ahead through 4-5 and into 6 — she has no reliable solo burst, and while Glacial Prison (R) is a strong engage, it's a single long-cooldown skillshot you can Wind Wall, making level 6 a skill check rather than a loss.
edits.after: Through 4-5 her Winter's Wrath (W) drops to 6s and keeps Frost on you for the Permafrost (E) stun, so break contact before max stacks. At 6, Wind Wall the Glacial Prison bola and punish any Arctic Assault knockup with Last Breath.

edits.before: Sejuani scales into a peel-and-engage tank with no 1v1 kill pressure; you gap-close, wall her R and W, and out-DPS her all game — she can absorb damage but never threatens to kill you.
edits.after: Sejuani scales into a peel-and-engage tank with no 1v1 kill pressure; you gap-close, wall the Glacial Prison bola, and out-DPS her — her W is not a projectile, so never save the wall for it.

edits.before: Trade freely since Sejuani lacks solo-lane burst to punish you
edits.after: Answer her Arctic Assault (Q) knockup with Last Breath (R) at 6

edits.before: Save Wind Wall for her Glacial Prison (R) engage at level 6
edits.after: Save Wind Wall for her Glacial Prison (R) bola at level 6

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Permafrost is up every 1.5s but only fires at max Frost, so the real clock is Winter's Wrath: 9s at rank 1, 5s at rank 5. - Arctic Assault: 18s at rank 1 — her knockup is the input Last Breath (70s at rank 1) needs, so hold R for her charge.

edits.before: Sejuani wastes Permafrost — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Wind Wall stops the Glacial Prison bola only, never Permafrost.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — Dash-Q stack into EQ-knockup.
edits.after: Her Arctic Assault knockup is a valid Last Breath target. Wind Wall the Glacial Prison bola; Permafrost is targeted and lands anyway.
